rules.title: Rent control coverage under Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. New construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums and certain HUD-subsidized units are registered but not rent controlled.
rules.key_value: Rent control covers most multifamily units built before 1980
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually with separate leases). Includes units with Housing Choice Voucher, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME and similar subsidies.
rules.exemptions: Not rent controlled (partially covered): new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; Section 202 and Section 811 units; Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or Project-based Section 8 units in projects with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage. Fully exempt: 'Golden Duplex' owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied; units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived on property when tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.extraction_note: Source is an informational guide table from the Berkeley Rent Board, not the ordinance text; no section numbers, rent cap formula, or effective/enacted dates are given. Cutoff stated as 'built before 1980' for full coverage while new construction is defined as Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; units completed January-June 1980 are not addressed. 1979-12-31 represents 'before 1980'.

rules.title: Just cause for eviction coverage under Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause eviction protections apply to fully and partially covered units, including new construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and specified subsidized units. Certain owner-occupied, ADU, university and cooperative units are exempt.
rules.key_value: Just cause applies to fully and partially covered units, including new construction and condos
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.coverage_text: Covered: multifamily units built before 1980; single family homes (any tenancy start date); rooming houses; new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; most condominiums; units with Section 202, Section 811 and listed HUD subsidies.
